scope: E55: explicit same-Xcode/SDK environment binding on three frozen new actual agentctl workloads; permissions unchanged, not default compiler replacement or inference optimization

toolchain_identity.version:
Apple clang version 21.0.0 (clang-2100.1.1.101)
Target: arm64-apple-darwin25.5.0
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Toolchains/XcodeDefault.xctoolchain/usr/bin

method.ordering: Rotate/reverse workloads and mode order per block; serial unsanitized; no concurrent correctness jobs or other controlled load
method.fresh_tasks: Task sources and expected values frozen before timing; not used for E54 tuning
method.baseline: Same Xcode default Clang and macOS SDK; on/off unbound versus explicitly bound on/off; preflight checks selected cc and SDK against bound realpaths
method.private_cache_control: Every task starts fresh CLI and private TMPDIR/HOME. Off creates and removes its own directory inside the timed CLI command; on uses normal sandbox prepare/cleanup. This differs from E53 usual warm-host-cache off and cannot be subtracted across stages.
method.timing_boundary: Python measures complete CLI process; fixture starts before timing, two scripted HTTP choices per task, no model inference. Includes OS prepare/cleanup/host protection and compilation/run. Inner phase is inside the tool command.
method.permissions: Default E53 allow/deny rules and logging retained; PATH/SDKROOT bindings do not add file, network or IPC grants. No persistent shared xcrun cache.
method.source_provenance: Measured source archive, binary hashes and Native validation manifest recorded; runtime sources must match at publication

development_failures.reason: Initial version oracle expected a clang filename rather than InstalledDir; corrected assertion. Existing 12 OS suites had passed.
Initial fixture expected process execution to fail, although E53 already grants process-exec. Corrected to attempt reading the actual outside file; no production permission change.

limits: Explicit binding is opt-in; zero-config standard /usr/bin shims still rebuild their private lookup cache and can regress.

Bound PATH uses the chosen bin plus fixed system paths and SDKROOT; tested only these macOS C/archive/C++ tasks. Not a proof of equivalence for arbitrary Xcode projects, iOS, alternative toolchains or software that needs extra discovery.
No universal DLP, VM isolation or protection of other unprotected same-UID process environments/argv. Linux/Windows backend remains fail-closed.
No exact decomposition of all Xcode retry/initialization time; direct API probe results are not full-workload waiting times.
No RSS or physical KV improvement measured; no new autonomous-agent quality or cloud/model speedup.
